provenance: Five unchanged lecture PDFs from a real MIT course. Questions and Chinese answer/locator notes authored for this evaluation; not collected from students. Labels fixed before any live search measurement.
page_numbering: 1-based physical PDF pages, including the MIT OCW attribution page; no page offsets or invented logical pages.

license.name: MIT OCW CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
license.note: Download originals from MIT. PDFs are not redistributed in this repository. Attribute Erik Demaine, Jason Ku, Justin Solomon and MIT OpenCourseWare.

language: English queries against English PDFs; Chinese notes for annotation review. Cross-language retrieval is not measured.

questions.question: My student IDs are huge numbers but I only have a few thousand students. Why is using each ID as an array index wasteful?
questions.locator: Direct Access Array，小节末尾的空间开销说明
questions.answer_summary: 按键空间大小分配数组，空间取决于 u 而非实际人数 n。

questions.question: Two different keys land in the same bucket. How does chaining let me keep both?
questions.locator: Chaining 小节首两条
questions.answer_summary: 让桶指向另一数据结构，保存落入该桶的多个元素。

questions.question: I use key modulo table size. Why doesn't that alone guarantee fast lookups for every input?
questions.locator: Hash Functions 下 Division 小节，固定函数的坏输入
questions.answer_summary: 固定函数总可能遇到大量碰撞的输入；表大小和键的分布会影响链长。

questions.question: When we randomize the hash function, what exactly is random in the expected constant-time claim?
questions.locator: Universal 小节的概率界与期望链长推导
questions.answer_summary: 对函数族中随机选择的函数取期望，而非假设输入键随机；装载因子须有界。

questions.question: A hash table resize is expensive. How can insertions still be called constant time?
questions.locator: Dynamic 小节三条
questions.answer_summary: 重建代价分摊到多次动态操作；结论是期望摊还常数时间。

questions.question: On a one-way road map, are the roads into a junction the same list as the roads out?
questions.locator: Neighbor Sets/Adjacencies 首两条
questions.answer_summary: 有向图分别记录入邻居和出邻居；两者通常不同。

questions.question: Why does storing a graph as neighbor lists take space for both vertices and edges?
questions.locator: Graph Representations 的结构大小与握手引理推导
questions.answer_summary: 顶点映射占 O(V)，所有邻接表合计占 O(E)。

questions.question: I need routes from one start to every destination. Do I have to store a separate full route for each?
questions.locator: Shortest Paths Tree 小节
questions.answer_summary: 保存每个可达顶点的前驱即可重建路径，树大小为 O(V)。

questions.question: Every move in my puzzle costs one step. How can I find the fewest moves without trying every possible route?
questions.locator: Breadth-First Search 的 level sets 与逐层扩展
questions.answer_summary: BFS 按距离逐层扩展，首次发现时设置距离与父节点。

questions.question: My BFS never reaches one vertex. What distance should I report for it?
questions.locator: BFS 初始化括号及遍历结束时的距离处理
questions.answer_summary: 不可达顶点的距离为无穷大。

questions.question: DFS found me a route. Can I assume it's the route with the fewest edges?
questions.locator: Depth-First Search 开头对返回树的说明
questions.answer_summary: 不能；DFS 保证可达性，不保证最短路径。

questions.question: A search from one vertex misses a separate island of vertices. How do I visit the whole graph?
questions.locator: Full-BFS and Full-DFS 的循环步骤
questions.answer_summary: 反复从未访问的顶点启动搜索，直至全部顶点被访问。

questions.question: How can I group an undirected network into separate connected islands using graph search?
questions.locator: Graph Connectivity 的证明最后一条
questions.answer_summary: 执行完整遍历，将每次单源搜索访问的顶点分为一个连通分量。

questions.question: My tasks have one-way prerequisites and no cycles. How do DFS finishing times give a valid task order?
questions.locator: Topological Sort 的 Finishing Order 与 Claim
questions.answer_summary: 完整 DFS 的完成顺序反转，得到 DAG 的拓扑序。

questions.question: While recursively exploring a directed graph, what sort of edge tells me I've found a cycle?
questions.locator: Cycle Detection，维护当前递归路径祖先的部分
questions.answer_summary: 指向当前路径上祖先的边表明存在有向环；已访问顶点不一定是祖先。

questions.question: Some roads have zero cost and others have negative cost. Which of those is allowed by Dijkstra's assumptions?
questions.locator: Review 最后一条及 Non-negative Edge Weights
questions.answer_summary: 允许零权边；该算法的保证要求边权非负，不能一般性接受负权边。

questions.question: I found a cheaper route to a vertex still waiting in Dijkstra's queue. What must I change in the queue?
questions.locator: Dijkstra's Algorithm，松弛步骤之后的队列更新
questions.answer_summary: 更新距离估计，并降低该顶点在可变优先队列中的键。

questions.question: Why is a vertex's distance final when Dijkstra removes it as the current minimum?
questions.locator: Correctness，移除顺序归纳及非负权不等式链
questions.answer_summary: 安全松弛与非负边权使最小估计在出队时等于真实最短距离。

questions.question: Should I use the same priority queue for a very dense graph and a very sparse one?
questions.locator: Running Time 表格下 dense 与 sparse 两条
questions.answer_summary: 稠密图数组可达 O(V²)；稀疏图二叉堆可达 O(V log V)。

questions.question: For Dijkstra's running time, how often do we build the queue, remove a minimum, and lower a key?
questions.locator: Running Time 的 Time/Occurrences 表
questions.answer_summary: 建队一次，删除最小值 V 次，降低键至多 E 次。

questions.question: My recursive Fibonacci function has only two short calls, so why does it get slow so quickly?
questions.locator: Fibonacci Numbers 的代码、递推运行时间及重复子问题
questions.answer_summary: 同一子问题被重复求解，递归调用树导致指数级工作。

questions.question: If I cache recursive answers or fill a table in order, am I solving different Fibonacci subproblems?
questions.locator: Re-using Subproblem Solutions 的 top-down/bottom-up 对照
questions.answer_summary: 子问题相同；前者按需缓存，后者按依赖拓扑序计算。

questions.question: The notes say Fibonacci needs linearly many additions. Is the actual runtime still linear when the integers get huge?
questions.locator: 本页末尾关于整数位数与每次加法代价的三条
questions.answer_summary: 大整数加法并非常数；按机器字长 w 计，总成本为 O(n+n²/w)。

questions.question: What makes dynamic programming different from just splitting a problem into independent recursive pieces?
questions.locator: Dynamic Programming，小节中依赖重叠的条目
questions.answer_summary: DP 的子问题依赖重叠，复用解；独立分治的依赖通常呈树状。

questions.question: In the bowling problem, why isn't the best choice always to hit the first pin immediately?
questions.locator: Bowling Algorithms，后半部 suffix DP 的三种选择
questions.answer_summary: 可能跳过、单独击倒或与下一瓶一起击倒；比较各选择的后缀总分。
